instruction: Open C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Writer Tasks\research_overview.odt in LibreOffice Writer. Apply the Heading 1 paragraph style to the paragraph containing exactly "Quarterly Research Summary". Leave the wording and paragraph order unchanged, then save the document.
_comments: D0 demonstration variant. This is the only recordable member of the family.

command:
from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, shutil, time; [subprocess.run(['taskkill','/F','/IM',image], capture_output=True, text=True) for image in ('swriter.exe','soffice.exe','soffice.bin')]; time.sleep(1); p=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Writer Tasks\research_overview.html'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text('Research Overview

Quarterly Research Summary

This report reviews the current research milestones.

The next review is scheduled for Friday.

', encoding='utf-8'); out=p.with_suffix('.odt'); out.unlink(missing_ok=True); (p.parent / f'.~lock.{out.name}#').unlink(missing_ok=True); profile=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Local\Temp\trace2task-writer-d0-setup'); shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True); result=subprocess.run([r'C:\Program Files\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe','-env:UserInstallation=file:///C:/Users/Docker/AppData/Local/Temp/trace2task-writer-d0-setup','--headless','--convert-to','odt','--outdir',str(p.parent),str(p)], check=True, timeout=60, capture_output=True, text=True); assert out.is_file(), 'LibreOffice conversion did not create ODT: ' + result.stdout + result.stderr; p.unlink(missing_ok=True); shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)

from pathlib import Path; import zipfile; import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; p=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Writer Tasks\research_overview.odt'); ns='urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0'; root=ET.fromstring(zipfile.ZipFile(p).read('content.xml')) if p.is_file() else ET.Element('missing'); heads=[''.join(node.itertext()).strip() for node in root.findall('.//{%s}h' % ns) if node.get('{%s}outline-level' % ns) == '1']; ok=heads == ['Quarterly Research Summary']; marker=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Writer Tasks\research_overview.heading1.complete'); marker.write_text('complete', encoding='utf-8') if ok else marker.unlink(missing_ok=True); print('true' if ok else 'false', end='')
